livePreview.description: The browser has a real-time chain for this effect (studio/preview/audio.js liveEffectGraph): an audio component made only of such blocks can be previewed live while a knob moves.

clientPreview.description: The browser previews this effect itself (clientside-preview.js); an audio component made only of such blocks has a browser preview.

name.description: The name of the stream the port carries: what a song writes after from and ->.

internalName.description: The older internal name of the port (in, out, mix, in3, render_in), only when it differs from name; it is not valid in a v1 song (lint L010).

alias.description: A hidden compatibility copy of another port of the same stream (the build still uses it): it is not listed in the docs and a song does not write it.

example.description: The text of a small .amplet song (v1 form) that uses a block of this type. A test parses it with the spec and requires no errors.

needs.description: What the block needs to make its sound: files (a drum kit folder, a SoundFont, a recording) or a plugin. Derived from the parameters of kind sampleset, file and engine.

soundSource.description: True when the block makes a sound by itself from notes, files or settings (it needs no audio input), so that its example can be rendered to hear it.
